summary: Smart Sand, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 2 to its existing $30 million senior secured asset-based credit facility with First-Citizens Bank & Trust Company. The amendment increases total revolving commitments by $20 million to $50 million, extends the maturity to September 1, 2031, and adds a $20 million sublimit supported by the Oakdale, Wisconsin facility, with a negative pledge on that property and a minimum excess liquidity test when utilized. Threshold adjustments and a $20 million unfinanced capital expenditure deduct for fixed charge coverage ratio are included. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation. Watch for continued covenant compliance and facility utilization.
